theorem1.statement: the tangent at any point of a circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact
theorem1.proof: every other point of the tangent lies outside the circle, else two shared points; so OQ > OP for all other Q; so OP is the shortest distance; and the shortest distance from a point to a line is along the perpendicular

tangentCount.interiorCaseGivenAReason: every line through an interior point meets the circle twice and so is a secant
